test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven birds — A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north. D sits third to the right of F, who sits at the second position from the left end. E sits between A and F. G sits to the left of F. B sits in the second position from the right end. Which of the following statements is true?

options.text: B sits exactly between D and A.
C sits at extreme right end.
F sits at extreme left end.
E sits to the immediate left of D.

solution:
Given: Seven birds — A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north. 

1) B sits in the second position from the right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1604256ebfa8158f98b7cd6cf14c536faecc6919506c4170339d867142232613.png] 

2) D sits third to the right of F, who sits at the second position from the left end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ad634eb981d5c90a637edd152b8353d037169f4107ea3aca8f2b27bd3665104.png] 

3) G sits to the left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6261d9d93898324f820c64a3cce0f612fcca3413a345d5b0c4bab7581c6c2f48.png] 

4) E sits between A and F. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da114ceead6e02d5361c9b6dec790bd18abfed0af4e197c4c4d37ff8732ddd04.png] 

Thus, the final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18970b003c0c44282dd80c76b8d8bb702fc70767cc1df3d02dad54113ce086da.png] 

Now,

B sits exactly between D and A - False.

C sits at extreme right end - **True**.

F sits at extreme left end - False.

E sits to the immediate left of D - False.

Hence, the correct statement is '__**option 2**__'.
